name: @boru-lang/parser
description: TypeScript port of the boru parser — source text to Value[]. The TS twin of the parser/go module: the front end and nothing else, a leaf over @boru-lang/core with no engine, no check pass and no compiler.

scripts.build:core-dev: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('../../core/ts/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p ../../core/ts/tsconfig.build.json
scripts.build: npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node -e "require('node:fs').copyFileSync('src/grammar.json', 'dist/grammar.json')"
